name: Conquer Your Screen Time
subtitle: Beat friends. Claim the crown.
promotionalText: Beat your friends. Claim the crown. Everyone starts the day with 1,000 points, and time on your phone spends them. At 8 AM, break the seal and see who kept more.
description:
Beat your friends. Claim the crown.

Conquer Your Screen Time turns putting your phone down into a game you play with friends. You each start every day with 1,000 points. Every 15 minutes on your phone costs a few, and social apps cost the most. Texting, calls and Maps are free.

SEALED UNTIL 8 AM
• Your friend's score stays sealed until 8 AM.
• Tap to break the wax seal and see who kept more.
• Win the day and the crown is yours.

UP TO SIX RIVALS
• Every battle is one on one. Your one score counts in each.
• Daily crowns, weekly crowns and the 30-Day Champion title.
• Widgets show your points left and where they went.

FREE TO PLAY
• Challenge any friend with a free invite code.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• The same costs for every player.
• Your minutes and apps stay on your phone. Only your daily point total is shared, and only with your rivals.
• Points come from the app's own count, which may differ a little from iPhone Screen Time.

DYNASTY (optional subscription)
• The all-time crown with each rival, a jewel for every month you win, your record book and year in review.
• Dynasty never changes who wins.

For ages 13 and up. A game to help you build better phone habits. It isn't medical advice or treatment.
reviewNotes: DRAFT, not sent to App Store Connect. Anyone can play; no code needed. To see a battle, the reviewer can use a pretend rival or a code from us. Screen Time: Family Controls individual authorization and DeviceActivity thresholds (15-minute steps) only. Fortress mode (Dynasty) uses ManagedSettings shields only when the player turns it on. Minutes and app choices stay on the device; only a daily points total (0 to 1,000) is sent, after the day ends, to the matched rivals.
